meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Google Chat 适配器从 channels 分支复制进 src/channels/,在频道入口文件追加一行注册导入,装好 @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0,然后构建并跑注册测试,让项目支持 Google Chat 频道。凭证等 Google Cloud 配置仍需人工在控制台完成。
howto.when: 当你要求为项目添加 Google Chat 频道接入时使用;若正处于 /setup 流程中,做完后回到该流程,否则运行 /manage-channels 把该频道接到 agent group。

say.text: 帮我给项目加上 Google Chat 频道接入
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 跑一下 gchat 的注册测试,确认适配器接好了
say.note: 执行 vitest 那条集成测试
会提示需整段单行服务账号 JSON

howto.what_en: Installs Google Chat support: copies the adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends a registration import to the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, then builds and runs the registration test. Google Cloud credentials are still set up manually.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add Google Chat channel support to the project. If you're mid-/setup, return to that flow afterwards; otherwise run /manage-channels to wire the channel to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add Google Chat channel support to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, runs the test

say_en.text: Run the gchat registration test to confirm it's wired up
say_en.note: Runs that single vitest integration test
Points out it needs the full one-line JSON
